title: Warp.Adapters — outbound service call observability + cluster-shared rate limiting
public_contracts: Warp.Core.Adapters.IWarpAdapters.BeginCall(string adapter, string operation, string? group = null) : AdapterCallScope (SetGroup/SetCorrelation/SetTag on scope)
Warp.Adapters.Http.WarpAdapterHttpOptions.UseSharedRateLimit(int limit, int perSeconds, AdapterRateLimitOverflow overflow, TimeSpan? maxWait)
Entities: warp.AdapterDefinition (incl. SharedPolicyJson/SharedPolicyHash/HasPolicyConflict), warp.AdapterCallLog (incl. GroupName, CorrelationId; row per call by default; always in schema)

success_criteria.description: Manual scope failure persists AdapterCallLog with exception details; success persists a row under default RecordCalls=All and none under FailuresOnly
Operation name precedence: request option > ambient scope > URL heuristic
Capture tiers None/OnFailure/Always with truncation + user-owned redaction
Calls write Counter rows aggregated by CounterAggregator into Statistics
Shared rate limiter: no cluster over-admission (BarrierSignal N=2), Wait delays, FailFast throws
ExpirationCleanup removes expired call logs and orphaned definitions
Adapter endpoints return definitions/stats/calls; addons flag reflects AddAdapters
Refit integration derives operation names from interface methods (stubbed handler)
Solution builds analyzer-clean with two new projects
Client-kind span {adapter}.{operation} + warp.adapter.* meters emitted per call
Frontend builds with Adapters pages + demo fixtures
Cardinality guard: heuristic operation names beyond MaxDistinctOperations collapse to {other} with one warning; explicit names never collapsed
Shared-policy conflict: differing process enforces persisted policy, increments warp.adapter.config_conflicts, flags definition
Adapter without BaseUrl routes absolute-URI requests through full pipeline unchanged
Groups: group recorded on row + counter key (incl. successes → per-group error rates), span attribute yes, meter tag only with IncludeGroupInMetrics; group-less calls unchanged
Group cardinality guard: values beyond MaxDistinctGroups collapse to {other} with one warning

out_of_scope: Webhook delivery — designed follow-up with its own spec: docs/specs/2026-07-10-warp-webhooks.md (depends on this spec's CorrelationId, groups, RecordCalls)
Shared (DB-backed) circuit breaker — fast-follow reusing CircuitBreakerState
SOAPAction-header fallback in the operation-name resolver (fast-follow; WithWarpOperation covers it)
GraphQL minimal client generator (Warp.Adapters.GraphQL) — designed fast-follow; not the rejected REST Refit-alike since no lightweight GraphQL equivalent exists
Replay of failed calls (requires explicit idempotency opt-in)
WCF/SOAP message-inspector, GraphQL operation-extraction, and gRPC interceptor binding packages
Public pluggable call-log storage (IAdapterCallStore stays internal)
Dashboard latency percentiles (OTel histograms cover this)
Any change to the worker fetch/execute hot path
assumptions: [ASSUMED] Polly attempt count readable for AdapterCallLog.Attempts; fallback: record 1 per logical call, document
[ASSUMED] existing IWarpSqlQueries bucket-lock method reusable for lease acquisition; else add LockRateLimitBucketByKeyAsync to both providers
[ASSUMED] Counter naming supports free-form adapter keys; confirm CounterAggregator grouping in batch 2
[VERIFIED:src/core/Warp.Core/RateLimit/RateLimitStore.cs] RateLimitBucket store exists; adapter limiter uses its own scope, not handler-scope commit semantics
risks: RecordCalls=All default writes a row per call — volume on hot adapters; mitigations: batched flushing, retention, per-adapter FailuresOnly
Per-attempt latency invisible in Warp rows (one row per logical call); visible via resilience OTel telemetry
AsyncLocal ambient operation name does not flow across manually created threads; request-option is the reliable path
Package naming Warp.Adapters.Http (outbound) vs Warp.Http (inbound) needs explicit docs
trap: see Rejected alternatives section in the .md spec

implement.behavioral_diff: New opt-in Adapters feature: IWarpAdapters.BeginCall scopes any outbound call (adapter/operation/group/correlation/tags) emitting unconditional OTel spans+meters; AddAdapters() adds lossy channel-based DB recording (AdapterCallLog row per call incl. redacted/truncated capture columns, Counter rows per adapter/operation/group incl. successes, AdapterDefinition registry) with ExpirationCleanup retention; Warp.Adapters.Http auto-scopes named HttpClients (fixed handler ordering, BaseUrl optional, naming precedence option>ambient>heuristic with cardinality guards) with optional Polly resilience and a DB-token-leased cluster-wide rate limiter (Wait/FailFast, shared-policy conflict detection); Warp.Adapters.Refit wraps Refit interfaces with per-method operation names; dashboard gains gated Adapters nav, fleet+detail pages, three REST endpoints, demo fixtures. Two tables added to schema unconditionally.
